run_agnews_k_shot_generation: run the AGNews module to generate 16-shot train dev and test splits for multiple random seeds
create_agnews_classification_dataset: create an AGNews classification dataset instance with World Sports Business and Sci/Tech labels
load_agnews_hf_dataset: load the AGNews dataset from Hugging Face using the ag_news identifier
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a Hugging Face AGNews dataset split to a list of text and label tuples
get_train_test_lines: get the train and test line tuples from an AGNews Hugging Face dataset
